sheet_reviews.contents: Sheet "POST4 Productive Rearrengments": header row plus 209103 productive TCRβ rearrangement rows (clone rank, clone and cumulative frequencies, templates, amino acid sequence, nucleotide rearrangement, V, D and J gene calls) for the PBMC-POST-4 sample.

blocks.contents: Header row: Clones (#), Clones (%), Cumulative frequency (%), Productive frequency (%), Templates, Amino acid, Rearrangement, v_resolved, d_resolved, j_resolved.

Rank-ordered unique productive rearrangement rows of one sequencing sample (PBMC-POST-4); the first two rows and the last row were read individually and the intervening rows share the same ten-column structure.
blocks.clinical_relevance_notes: Raw clonotype list from TCRβ sequencing of a sample of the patient; individual clone sequences and frequencies are not typed as clinical facts, and sample-level summary counts are typed from the supplementary methods and article text instead.

ownership_evidence.quote: TCRβ sequence analyses were performed in the SC mts TIL and in PBMC samples obtained before (PBMC-PRE), during CSF-470 immunization (PBMC-POST-1 and PBMC-POST-3), and 2 years after completing the vaccine protocol (PBMC-POST-4)

limitations: Only the header, first two rows and last row were read cell by cell; the remaining rows were summarized as a homogeneous list and no per-clone value is transcribed.
Per-clone sequences and frequencies are not transcribed.
Raw clonotype lists are classified as background raw data; no per-clone values are typed as clinical facts.
